trials.title: Phase II Trial of Chemotherapy in Sporadic and Neurofibromatosis Type 1 Associated High Grade Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
interventions: Doxorubicin hydrochloride 37.5 mg/m2/dose IV over 15 minutes on days 1, 2
Ifosfamide 1,800 mg/m2/dose IV over 60 minutes on days 1-5
Etoposide 100 mg/m2/dose IV over 60 minutes on days 1-5

adverse_events.neurotoxicity_dose_reductions: 3/48 patients had dose reductions due to ifosfamide neurotoxicity
adverse_events.cardiotoxicity_monitoring: Ejection fraction required to be normal by echocardiogram or MUGA at baseline; doxorubicin could not be administered concurrently with radiation therapy

trials.toxicity_mitigation_notes: Standard monitoring only; no active cardioprotection strategy employed
trials.relevance: Direct evidence for doxorubicin efficacy in NF1-associated MPNST; demonstrates anthracycline responsiveness (18% PR in NF1 patients) but highlights hematologic toxicity. No cardioprotection beyond baseline screening.
trials.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00304083, completed Phase 2 trial with published results

trials.title: Early Phase Study to Evaluate the MEK Inhibitor Selumetinib With the MDM2 Inhibitor APG-115 in Patients With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 and Pre-malignant and Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
trials.primary_outcomes: Safety, tolerability, and preliminary efficacy of MEK + MDM2 inhibition
trials.relevance: Novel combination strategy for NF1-MPNST using targeted therapy (MEK inhibitor) instead of cytotoxic chemotherapy. Could represent alternative to anthracycline-based regimens with different toxicity profile.
trials.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06735820, actively recruiting early-phase trial

trials.title: A Phase 2 Trial of the MEK Inhibitor PD-0325901 in Adolescents and Adults With NF1-Associated Morbid Plexiform Neurofibromas
trials.relevance: Demonstrates MEK inhibitor efficacy in NF1 benign tumors (not MPNST). Potential combination partner with doxorubicin for synergistic anti-tumor effect while potentially allowing dose reduction of anthracycline.
trials.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02096471, completed Phase 2 trial with results

cardioprotection_trials.title: Randomized Phase II Trial Of Interventional Therapy Investigate Cardiac Protection of Dexrazoxane In Women With Breast Cancer Having Experienced Grade 1 Cardiotoxicity During Prior Anthracycline-based Chemotherapy
cardioprotection_trials.relevance: Directly addresses anthracycline cardioprotection using dexrazoxane, the only FDA-approved cardioprotectant for anthracyclines. Could be adapted for NF1 patients receiving doxorubicin-based regimens.
cardioprotection_trials.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00955890, terminated trial but establishes precedent for dexrazoxane use

cardioprotection_trials.title: Cardioprotection With Dexrazoxane in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), High-Risk Myelodysplastic Syndrome (MDS), Myeloid Blast Phase of Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML), Ph+ AML, and Myeloid Blast Phase of Myeloproliferative Neoplasms
interventions: Dexrazoxane hydrochloride (cardioprotective agent with anthracycline-based chemotherapy)
cardioprotection_trials.relevance: Active trial demonstrating contemporary use of dexrazoxane for cardioprotection during anthracycline therapy in hematologic malignancies. Provides safety/efficacy data applicable to NF1-MPNST patients receiving doxorubicin.
cardioprotection_trials.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03589729, actively recruiting trial at MD Anderson Cancer Center

combination_therapy_trials.title: MEK Inhibitor Selumetinib + MDM2 Inhibitor APG-115 in NF1-MPNST
combination_therapy_trials.strategy: Targeted therapy combination (MEK + MDM2 inhibition) for pre-malignant and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors
combination_therapy_trials.relevance: Novel non-cytotoxic combination approach for NF1-MPNST that could avoid anthracycline toxicity entirely or be combined with lower-dose doxorubicin.

combination_therapy_trials.title: Trametinib for Patients With Pediatric Glioma or Plexiform Neurofibroma With Refractory Tumor and Activation of the MAPK/ERK Pathway
combination_therapy_trials.strategy: MEK inhibitor monotherapy for MAPK-driven tumors including NF1-associated neurofibromas
combination_therapy_trials.relevance: Demonstrates MEK inhibitor efficacy in NF1-related tumors; potential for combination with reduced-dose anthracyclines in MPNST to maintain efficacy while reducing cardiotoxicity.

search_strategies.key_finding: NCT00304083 - completed Phase 2 trial of doxorubicin + ifosfamide + etoposide in NF1-MPNST with published results
NCT07707947 - NF2 trial with selumetinib (not directly relevant to NF1 + doxorubicin cardiotoxicity)
Multiple trials of MEK inhibitors (selumetinib, trametinib, PD-0325901) in NF1 plexiform neurofibromas; NCT06735820 specifically targets MPNST with selumetinib + MDM2 inhibitor combination
NCT03589729 (recruiting) and NCT00955890 (terminated) demonstrate dexrazoxane use for anthracycline cardioprotection

key_insights.nf1_doxorubicin_evidence: Limited to one completed Phase 2 trial (NCT00304083) showing 18% partial response rate in NF1-MPNST with doxorubicin-based combination chemotherapy. No trials specifically address cardiotoxicity mitigation in this population.
key_insights.cardioprotection_options: Dexrazoxane is FDA-approved cardioprotectant with active trials in hematologic malignancies (NCT03589729). No NF1-specific cardioprotection trials identified.
key_insights.alternative_strategies: Multiple MEK inhibitor trials in NF1 (selumetinib, trametinib, PD-0325901) suggest targeted therapy alternatives or combination strategies that could reduce anthracycline exposure while maintaining anti-tumor efficacy.
key_insights.combination_potential: NCT06735820 (MEK + MDM2 inhibition in NF1-MPNST) represents novel targeted combination approach that could be synergistic with reduced-dose anthracyclines.
evidence_gaps: No trials specifically examining doxorubicin + dexrazoxane in NF1-MPNST
No trials testing MEK inhibitor + anthracycline combinations in NF1
Limited long-term cardiac safety data for anthracyclines in NF1 population
No pediatric-specific cardioprotection trials in NF1-MPNST despite disease occurrence in children

clinical_implications.current_standard: Doxorubicin + ifosfamide + etoposide remains the only tested cytotoxic regimen in NF1-MPNST based on NCT00304083, but showed modest response rates (18% PR) with significant toxicity.
clinical_implications.toxicity_concerns: 13% febrile neutropenia, 8% anemia, neurotoxicity requiring dose reductions in 6% of patients. Cardiac monitoring required but no active cardioprotection employed.
clinical_implications.emerging_options: MEK inhibitor monotherapy or combinations may offer less toxic alternatives; ongoing trials (NCT06735820) will provide data on targeted therapy efficacy in MPNST.
clinical_implications.cardioprotection_strategy: Dexrazoxane could be considered off-label for NF1-MPNST patients receiving anthracyclines, based on evidence from other cancers (NCT03589729, NCT00955890).
